customers.usage_stats: 111 applications created last month (+17% MoM); increased firm-level usage from pilot (Erickson), but with variable engagement post-signing.

team.operation_notes: Lost momentum post-signing new firms due to onboarding handoff issues: paralegals, after decision-maker sign-off, often lack enough context/training and do not activate or retain effectively, affecting usage.

company_lowlights.description: Lost momentum after signing some firms: Signatory decision-makers hand off to paralegals without sufficient onboarding/context, resulting in lack of retention/usage.
company_lowlights.impact: Low activation and retention for some newly-signed customers.

company_lowlights.description: Strong dependence on a few anchor customers whose usage patterns are inconsistent. One key customer reduced applications from $7K/month to $2K/month, negatively impacting top-line revenue.
company_lowlights.impact: Revenue volatility and risk from concentration.

product_updates.description: Launched E-2 Visa drafting suite; now covering all typical corporate immigration needs.
product_updates.impact: Significantly expands product breadth and marketability.

events.description: Launched E-2 Visa on the platform, announced on LinkedIn.

notes: Slight revenue decline MoM due to high-variance anchor customer usage. Five new firms signed, though some firms slow to adopt product after signing. Growing organically as customers ask for broader support (e.g. document collection, evidence assessment). Firm visit to DC planned for onboarding push.
